 Two of the top three picks from the 2024 NFL Draft are set to face off in an exciting matchup on "Thursday Night Football."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Caleb Williams was the top pick in a quarterback-heavy draft that year and has since led the Chicago Bears to the playoffs and an NFL North title. After missing three games with an injury earlier this season, Williams returned to action last week and helped the offense dominate, as he continues to be one of the best quarterbacks in the NFL.
 Williams and the Bears will play host to the New England Patriots and Drake Maye, who went No. 3 overall in the 2024 NFL Draft. Maye, who brought the Patriots to the Super Bowl last year, started slow but has picked it up lately with at least three touchdowns in each of his last three games.
 With both teams seemingly hitting their stride, this matchup promises to be an intriguing contest between two Super Bowl contenders.
 Here's what you need to know to watch "Thursday Night Football" this week.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Who plays on 'Thursday Night Football' tonight?
 Matchup : Bears vs. Patriots
 Location : Soldier Field, Chicago
 The Bears will host the Patriots on "Thursday Night Football" from Soldier Field in Chicago, Illinois.
 What time is the NFL game on tonight?
 Date : Thursday, October 22
 Time : 8:15 p.m. ET
 Kickoff of Bears vs. Patriots is scheduled to kick off at 8:15 p.m. ET on Thursday, October 22.
 What channel is 'Thursday Night Football' on?
 TV channel : N/A
 Live stream : Prime Video 
 The Bears-Patriots game on "Thursday Night Football" will air on Prime Video with Al Michaels and Kirk Herbstreit on the call. It will also air on ABC in the New England area and Fox in Chicago.
 Amazon Prime offers a free trial, allowing new users to tune into Thursday's game and everything the service has to offer before committing.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement 'Thursday Night Football' radio station
 Radio station: SiriusXM app and channels 192, 193
 Play-by-play radio coverage of Bears vs. Patriots can be found on the SiriusXM app, or on channels 192 (Bears broadcast) and 193 (Patriots broadcast).
